decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to satisfy the discharge of conditions, arboricultural impact assessment (4), dropped kerb (5), cycle parking (6) and construction management plan (8) of permission ref: 22/03060/FUL. It is therefore considered that the submission fails to comply with policies DMD45, DMD47, DMD48 and DMD80 of the Development Management Document (2014), CP 25 and CP30 of the Core Strategy (2010), T7 and G7 of the London Plan (2021) as well as the advice contained within the NPPF (2024).
description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 22/03060/FUL: external finishing materials (3), arboricultural impact assessment (4), dropped kerb (5), cycle parking (6), construction management plan (8) and energy statement (9) in respect of subdivision of site and erection of a detached single family dwellinghouse at rear.
